verdict.rationale: Egnyte documents its own automation features: multi-step workflows with automatic and AI steps plus webhooks, rules that automatically watermark documents on delivery, and agents configurable to automate processes across content and apps. These are marketing-level pricing and homepage claims only, with no detail on background triggers, recurring schedules, or how autonomously agents run unattended. Missing for 10: documented event or scheduled triggers for unattended background runs, depth on how autonomously agents execute, run monitoring or logs, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Multi-step ad-hoc and template-based workflows with automatic and manual steps, AI steps, and webhooks for external system integration.
Set up rules to automatically watermark sensitive documents upon delivery.
Configure agents to automate processes across your content and apps.
Custom agents can be built without code using the AI Agent Builder.
